# LaptopRent — Best Laptop Rentals in India

> LaptopRent is India's premier laptop and IT equipment rental platform. LaptopRent is a brand owned and operated by **STAGE-X** (Sole Proprietorship, Bengaluru). Rent Apple MacBook, gaming, business, and mobile workstation laptops with doorstep same-day delivery across 25+ Indian cities and full 18% GST input tax credit invoices.

## Core Products & Monthly Rental Rates
- **Student Laptops**: From ₹849 to ₹1,500 / month (Core i3/i5, 8GB RAM, SSD).
- **Business Laptops**: From ₹1,200 to ₹2,800 / month (Dell Latitude, HP ProBook, Lenovo ThinkPad, 16GB RAM).
- **Apple MacBook Air**: From ₹2,999 to ₹6,500 / month (Apple Silicon M1, M2, M3).
- **Apple MacBook Pro**: From ₹4,500 to ₹15,000 / month (M1/M2/M3 Pro & Max chips, 16GB–64GB Unified Memory).
- **Gaming Laptops**: From ₹3,500 to ₹8,000 / month (ASUS ROG/TUF, Lenovo Legion, Acer Predator, RTX 3050 to RTX 4080).
- **Mobile AI Workstations**: From ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 / month (32GB–64GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX A-series, dedicated thermal architecture).

## Rental Policies & Payment Terms
- **₹50 Reservation Token**: Nominal advance booking fee credited 100% against the 1st month's rental invoice. Refundable within 24–48 hours if cancelled before dispatch.
- **Security Deposit**: 0.5–1.5 months refundable deposit for individuals; 100% deposit waiver available for verified corporate clients on long-term leases. Refunded within 5–7 business days post inspection.
- **GST Invoicing**: 18% GST input tax credit invoice provided with corporate PAN/GSTIN for complete tax deductibility.
- **Delivery**: Complimentary same-day delivery in major metros for bookings placed before 2:00 PM; scheduled doorstep delivery nationwide.
- **Hardware Maintenance**: 100% free repair or swap guarantee for hardware malfunctions under normal wear-and-tear.
